example.zh: 他一下班便回家了。
example.en: He went home as soon as he got off work.
example.py: Tā yī xiàbān biàn huíjiā le.

words.source_def: (adv.) convenience; excrement or urine; relieve oneself

example.zh: 我对中国古代历史很感兴趣。
example.en: I'm very interested in ancient Chinese history.
example.py: Wǒ duì zhōngguó gǔdài lìshǐ hěngǎnxìngqù.

example.zh: 每个人都有自己的生活方式。
example.en: Everyone has their own way of life.
example.py: Měigè rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ de shēnghuó fāngshì.

example.zh: 你知道如何才能学好汉语吗？
example.en: Do you know how to learn Chinese well?
example.py: Nǐ zhīdào rúhé cáinéng xuéhǎo hànyǔ ma?

words.english: to produce; to give rise to

example.zh: 他对中国文化产生了很大的兴趣。
example.en: He developed a great interest in Chinese culture.
example.py: Tā duì zhōngguó wénhuà chǎnshēng le hěndà de xìngqù.

example.zh: 这是北京最高的建筑。
example.en: This is the tallest building in Beijing.
example.py: Zhè shì běijīng zuìgāo de jiànzhù.

words.english: to use; to make use of

example.zh: 他利用周末的时间学习开车。
example.en: He uses his weekends to learn to drive.
example.py: Tā lìyòng zhōumò de shíjiān xuéxí kāichē.

words.source_def: (v.) make use of; take advantage of

example.zh: 目前这个问题还没有解决。
example.en: At present this problem has not been solved.
example.py: Mùqián zhège wèntí hái méiyǒu jiějué.

example.zh: 我们老板对每个人都很客气。
example.en: Our boss is polite to everyone.
example.py: Wǒmen lǎobǎn duì měigè rén dōu hěn kèqi.

example.zh: 这个蛋糕是她亲手制作的。
example.en: She made this cake with her own hands.
example.py: Zhège dàngāo shì tā qīnshǒu zhìzuò de.

example.zh: 他正在忙着写毕业论文。
example.en: He is busy writing his graduation thesis.
example.py: Tā zhèngzài máng zhe xiě bìyè lùnwén.

example.zh: 我们一起分析一下失败的原因。
example.en: Let's analyse the reasons for the failure together.
example.py: Wǒmen yìqǐ fēnxī yíxià shībài de yuányīn.

example.zh: 他们俩在同一个单位上班。
example.en: The two of them work at the same workplace.
example.py: Tāmen liǎ zài tóngyīgè dānwèi shàngbān.

example.zh: 学校组织学生去参观长城。
example.en: The school organized a student visit to the Great Wall.
example.py: Xuéxiào zǔzhī xuésheng qù cānguān chángchéng.

example.zh: 学习要和练习结合起来。
example.en: Study should be combined with practice.
example.py: Xuéxí yào hé liànxí jiéhé qǐlái.

example.zh: 在公共场所大声说话是不礼貌的行为。
example.en: Talking loudly in public places is impolite behaviour.
example.py: Zài gōnggòngchǎngsuǒ dàshēng shuōhuà shì bùlǐmào de xíngwéi.

example.zh: 他今年的目标是通过五级考试。
example.en: His goal this year is to pass the level 5 exam.
example.py: Tā jīnnián de mùbiāo shì tōngguò wǔjí kǎoshì.

example.zh: 这家公司主要生产儿童家具。
example.en: This company mainly produces children's furniture.
example.py: Zhèjiā gōngsī zhǔyào shēngchǎn értóng jiājù.

example.zh: 这是一种很普遍的社会现象。
example.en: This is a very common social phenomenon.
example.py: Zhè shì yì zhǒng hěn pǔbiàn de shèhuì xiànxiàng.

example.zh: 这是我们饭店的特色菜。
example.en: This is our restaurant's specialty dish.
example.py: Zhè shì wǒmen fàndiàn de tèsè cài.

words.english: to pat; to clap; to take (a photo); to shoot (a film)

example.zh: 他给孩子们拍了很多照片。
example.en: He took many photos of the children.
example.py: Tā gěi háizi men pāi le hěnduō zhàopiàn.

words.source_def: (v.) to clap; slap; bat; racket; to take (a photo)

example.zh: 这座大楼是谁设计的？
example.en: Who designed this building?
example.py: Zhè zuò dàlóu shì shuí shèjì de?

example.zh: 他每天锻炼，从而提高了身体的健康水平。
example.en: He exercises every day, thereby improving his health.
example.py: Tā měitiān duànliàn, cóng'ér tígāo le shēntǐ de jiànkāng shuǐpíng.

example.zh: 所有工作人员都必须参加明天的会议。
example.en: All staff must attend tomorrow's meeting.
example.py: Suǒyǒu gōngzuò rényuán dōu bìxū cānjiā míngtiān de huìyì.

example.zh: 他在一家大企业工作。
example.en: He works for a large enterprise.
example.py: Tā zài yì jiā dà qǐyè gōngzuò.

example.zh: 这是学习汉语最基本的要求。
example.en: This is the most basic requirement for learning Chinese.
example.py: Zhè shì xuéxí hànyǔ zuì jīběn de yāoqiú.

example.zh: 周末他喜欢在家享受安静的生活。
example.en: At weekends he likes to enjoy a quiet life at home.
example.py: Zhōumò tā xǐhuan zàijiā xiǎngshòu ānjìng de shēnghuó.

example.zh: 他很注意自己在别人心中的形象。
example.en: He pays great attention to his image in others' eyes.
example.py: Tā hěn zhùyì zìjǐ zài biérén xīnzhōng de xíngxiàng.

example.zh: 同学们正在教室里做实验。
example.en: The students are doing an experiment in the classroom.
example.py: Tóngxuémen zhèngzài jiàoshì lǐ zuò shíyàn.

example.zh: 这家公司的产品质量很好。
example.en: This company's products are of good quality.
example.py: Zhèjiā gōngsī de chǎnpǐn zhìliàng hěn hǎo.

example.zh: 老师对他的评价很高。
example.en: The teacher thinks very highly of him.
example.py: Lǎoshī duì tā de píngjià hěn gāo.

words.english: to handle; to go through (a procedure)

example.zh: 请到三号窗口办理签证。
example.en: Please go to window 3 to process your visa.
example.py: Qǐng dào sānhào chuāngkǒu bànlǐ qiānzhèng.

example.zh: 我们的领导对工作要求很严格。
example.en: Our leader is very strict about work.
example.py: Wǒmen de lǐngdǎo duì gōngzuò yāoqiú hěn yángé.

example.zh: 考试前他做了充分的准备。
example.en: He prepared fully before the exam.
example.py: Kǎoshì qián tā zuò le chōngfèn de zhǔnbèi.

example.zh: 他负责公司的一个新项目。
example.en: He is in charge of a new project at the company.
example.py: Tā fùzé gōngsī de yí gè xīn xiàngmù.

example.zh: 这张画的色彩非常丰富。
example.en: The colours of this painting are very rich.
example.py: Zhè zhāng huà de sècǎi fēichángfēngfù.

example.zh: 这家公司有五百多名员工。
example.en: This company has over five hundred employees.
example.py: Zhèjiā gōngsī yǒu wǔbǎiduōmíng yuángōng.

example.zh: 作为老师，他对学生非常负责。
example.en: As a teacher, he is very responsible towards his students.
example.py: Zuòwéi lǎoshī, tā duì xuésheng fēicháng fùzé.

example.zh: 我通常七点起床。
example.en: I usually get up at seven.
example.py: Wǒ tōngcháng qīdiǎn qǐchuáng.

example.zh: 这些照片我一直保存着。
example.en: I have always kept these photos.
example.py: Zhèxiē zhàopiàn wǒ yìzhí bǎocún zhe.

example.zh: 他是研究儿童教育的专家。
example.en: He is an expert in children's education.
example.py: Tā shì yánjiū értóngjiàoyù de zhuānjiā.

example.zh: 他在杂志上发表了一篇文章。
example.en: He published an article in a magazine.
example.py: Tā zài zázhì shàng fābiǎo le yì piān wénzhāng.

example.zh: 没有人知道未来会发生什么。
example.en: Nobody knows what will happen in the future.
example.py: Méiyǒu rén zhīdào wèilái huì fāshēng shénme.

example.zh: 这辆车不属于他，是他朋友的。
example.en: This car doesn't belong to him; it's his friend's.
example.py: Zhèliàng chē bù shǔyú tā, shì tā péngyou de.

words.source_def: (v.) belong to; be part of; pertain to

example.zh: 这个地区的冬天特别冷。
example.en: Winter in this region is especially cold.
example.py: Zhège dìqū de dōngtiān tèbié lěng.

example.zh: 保护环境是全人类的责任。
example.en: Protecting the environment is the responsibility of all mankind.
example.py: Bǎohùhuánjìng shì quán rénlèi de zérèn.

example.zh: 请写清楚您的名字、地址以及电话号码。
example.en: Please write clearly your name, address and phone number.
example.py: Qǐng xiě qīngchu nín de míngzi, dìzhǐ yǐjí diànhuàhàomǎ.

words.source_def: (conj.) as well as; along with; and

example.zh: 他在这次比赛中表现得很好。
example.en: He performed very well in this competition.
example.py: Tā zài zhècì bǐsài zhōng biǎoxiàn de hěn hǎo.

example.zh: 这几年，人们的生活条件改善了很多。
example.en: In recent years people's living conditions have improved a lot.
example.py: Zhè jǐnián, rénmen de shēnghuó tiáojiàn gǎishàn le hěnduō.

example.zh: 他们每天下午训练两个小时。
example.en: They train for two hours every afternoon.
example.py: Tāmen měitiān xiàwǔ xùnliàn liǎnggè xiǎoshí.

example.zh: 我们尝了很多当地的小吃。
example.en: We tried many local snacks.
example.py: Wǒmen cháng le hěnduō dāngdì de xiǎochī.

example.zh: 两国的交流促进了经济的发展。
example.en: Exchanges between the two countries promoted economic development.
example.py: Liǎng guó de jiāoliú cùjìn le jīngjì de fāzhǎn.

example.zh: 他在一家汽车公司做销售工作。
example.en: He works in sales at a car company.
example.py: Tā zài yì jiā qìchē gōngsī zuò xiāoshòu gōngzuò.

example.zh: 遇到困难时，抱怨没有用。
example.en: When you meet difficulties, complaining is useless.
example.py: Yùdàokùnnán shí, bàoyuàn méiyǒu yòng.

example.zh: 调查结果显示，大多数人对工作满意。
example.en: The survey results show that most people are satisfied with their jobs.
example.py: Diàochájiéguǒ xiǎnshì, dàduōshù rén duì gōngzuò mǎnyì.

example.zh: 他大学学的是儿童心理。
example.en: He studied child psychology at university.
example.py: Tā dàxué xué de shì értóng xīnlǐ.

example.zh: 孩子的房间里到处都是玩具。
example.en: There are toys everywhere in the child's room.
example.py: Háizi de fángjiān lǐ dàochù dōu shì wánjù.

example.zh: 这件事情我会马上处理。
example.en: I'll deal with this matter right away.
example.py: Zhèjiàn shìqing wǒhuì mǎshàng chǔlǐ.

example.zh: 我进去的时候，他正在打电话。
example.en: When I went in, he was just making a phone call.
example.py: Wǒ jìnqù de shíhou, tā zhèng zài dǎdiànhuà.

example.zh: 这是公司内部的事，不要告诉别人。
example.en: This is an internal company matter; don't tell others.
example.py: Zhè shì gōngsī nèibù de shì, bú yào gàosu biérén.

example.zh: 很多媒体的记者都来参加了今天的活动。
example.en: Reporters from many media outlets came to today's event.
example.py: Hěnduō méitǐ de jìzhě dōu lái cānjiā le jīntiān de huódòng.

example.zh: 大家都称他为“王老师”。
example.en: Everyone calls him "Teacher Wang".
example.py: Dàjiā dōu chēng tā wéi “wánglǎoshī”.

words.english: measure word for buildings (schools, hospitals); that which

example.zh: 我们家附近有一所小学。
example.en: There is a primary school near our home.
example.py: Wǒmen jiā fùjìn yǒu yī suǒ xiǎoxué.

words.source_def: (mw.) [2nd syllable of many places]; [measure word for houses, buildings, institutions]

example.zh: 他是这本小说里的主要人物。
example.en: He is the main character in this novel.
example.py: Tā shì zhèběn xiǎoshuō lǐ de zhǔyào rénwù.

example.zh: 开车时要和前面的车保持距离。
example.en: When driving, keep your distance from the car in front.
example.py: Kāichē shí yào hé qiánmian de chē bǎochí jùlí.

example.zh: 如今越来越多的人在网上买东西。
example.en: Nowadays more and more people shop online.
example.py: Rújīn yuèláiyuè duō de rén zài wǎngshàng mǎi dōngxi.

example.zh: 他昨天做了一个小手术。
example.en: He had a minor operation yesterday.
example.py: Tā zuótiān zuò le yí gè xiǎo shǒushù.

example.zh: 长时间看手机会导致眼睛不舒服。
example.en: Looking at your phone for long periods can cause eye discomfort.
example.py: Cháng shíjiān kàn shǒujī huì dǎozhì yǎnjing bù shūfu.

words.source_def: (v.) to cause; lead to; result in

example.zh: 我们学校位于城市的东边。
example.en: Our school is located in the east of the city.
example.py: Wǒmen xuéxiào wèiyú chéngshì de dōngbiān.

example.zh: 老师多次强调了这个语法的重要性。
example.en: The teacher repeatedly stressed the importance of this grammar point.
example.py: Lǎoshī duōcì qiángdiào le zhège yǔfǎ de zhòngyàoxìng.

example.zh: 会说两种语言是他找工作的优势。
example.en: Speaking two languages is his advantage in job hunting.
example.py: Huì shuō liǎngzhǒng yǔyán shì tā zhǎo gōngzuò de yōushì.

example.zh: 爷爷八十岁了，看起来还很精神。
example.en: Grandpa is eighty but still looks full of life.
example.py: Yéye bāshísuì le, kànqǐlái hái hěn jīngshén.

example.zh: 这些数据是我们调查了一年才得到的。
example.en: It took us a year of surveying to get this data.
example.py: Zhèxiē shùjù shì wǒmen diàochá le yì nián cái dédào de.

example.zh: 用电脑工作可以提高效率。
example.en: Working with a computer can raise efficiency.
example.py: Yòng diànnǎo gōngzuò kěyǐ tígāo xiàolǜ.

example.zh: 春节吃饺子是中国北方的传统。
example.en: Eating dumplings at Spring Festival is a tradition in northern China.
example.py: Chūnjié chījiǎozi shì zhōngguó běifāng de chuántǒng.

example.zh: 这家商店的水果种类很多。
example.en: This shop has many kinds of fruit.
example.py: Zhèjiā shāngdiàn de shuǐguǒ zhǒnglèi hěnduō.

example.zh: 我临时有事，不能参加会议了。
example.en: Something came up at the last moment; I can't attend the meeting.
example.py: Wǒ línshí yǒushì, bùnéng cānjiā huìyì le.

example.zh: 这场大雨造成了严重的堵车。
example.en: This heavy rain caused serious traffic jams.
example.py: Zhèchǎng dàyǔ zàochéng le yánzhòng de dǔchē.

words.source_def: (v.) give rise to; bring about; cause

example.zh: 你能给我推荐一本好书吗？
example.en: Can you recommend a good book to me?
example.py: Nǐ néng gěi wǒ tuījiàn yì běn hǎoshū ma?

example.zh: 这座房子的样子很独特。
example.en: The look of this house is very distinctive.
example.py: Zhè zuò fángzi de yàngzi hěn dútè.

example.zh: 请问，图书馆在什么位置？
example.en: Excuse me, where is the library located?
example.py: Qǐngwèn, túshūguǎn zài shénme wèizhi?

example.zh: 天气逐渐变暖和了。
example.en: The weather is gradually getting warmer.
example.py: Tiānqì zhújiàn biàn nuǎnhuo le.

example.zh: 警察站在路口指挥交通。
example.en: A police officer stands at the intersection directing traffic.
example.py: Jǐngchá zhàn zài lùkǒu zhǐhuī jiāotōng.

example.zh: 他对公司的业务非常熟悉。
example.en: He is very familiar with the company's business.
example.py: Tā duì gōngsī de yèwù fēicháng shúxī.

example.zh: 他的病需要住院治疗。
example.en: His illness requires treatment in hospital.
example.py: Tā de bìng xūyào zhùyuàn zhìliáo.

words.english: to pretend; to load; to install

example.zh: 他把所有的衣服都装进了行李箱。
example.en: He packed all his clothes into the suitcase.
example.py: Tā bǎ suǒyǒu de yīfu dōu zhuāng jìn le xínglǐxiāng.

example.zh: 周末我们去参观了历史博物馆。
example.en: At the weekend we visited the history museum.
example.py: Zhōumò wǒmen qù cānguān le lìshǐ bówùguǎn.

example.zh: 父母应该从小培养孩子的阅读习惯。
example.en: Parents should cultivate reading habits in children from an early age.
example.py: Fùmǔ yīnggāi cóngxiǎo péiyǎng háizi de yuèdú xíguàn.

example.zh: 我想去南方体验一下那里的生活。
example.en: I'd like to go to the south to experience life there.
example.py: Wǒ xiǎng qù nánfāng tǐyàn yíxià nàlǐ de shēnghuó.

example.zh: 这个学期他的汉语进步很大。
example.en: His Chinese has improved a lot this semester.
example.py: Zhège xuéqī tā de hànyǔ jìnbù hěndà.

example.zh: 遇到问题要先自己思考。
example.en: When you meet a problem, first think it over yourself.
example.py: Yùdào wèntí yào xiān zìjǐ sīkǎo.

example.zh: 这家医院的设备很先进。
example.en: This hospital's equipment is very advanced.
example.py: Zhèjiā yīyuàn de shèbèi hěn xiānjìn.

example.zh: 哥哥喜欢打篮球，弟弟则喜欢踢足球。
example.en: The older brother likes basketball, whereas the younger likes football.
example.py: Gēge xǐhuan dǎlánqiú, dìdi zé xǐhuan tīzúqiú.

words.english: to do an internship; to practise

example.zh: 他现在在一家医院实习。
example.en: He is now doing an internship at a hospital.
example.py: Tā xiànzài zài yì jiā yīyuàn shíxí.

example.zh: 这只是我个人的看法。
example.en: This is only my personal view.
example.py: Zhè zhǐshì wǒ gèrén de kànfǎ.

example.zh: 希望我们以后还有机会合作。
example.en: I hope we'll have a chance to cooperate again in the future.
example.py: Xīwàng wǒmen yǐhòu háiyǒu jīhuì hézuò.

example.zh: 牛奶和鸡蛋都很有营养。
example.en: Milk and eggs are both very nutritious.
example.py: Niúnǎi hé jīdàn dōu hěn yǒu yíngyǎng.

example.zh: 他很善于和别人交流。
example.en: He is very good at communicating with others.
example.py: Tā hěn shànyú hé biérén jiāoliú.

words.source_def: (v.) be good at; be adept in

example.zh: 我们的篮球教练非常严格。
example.en: Our basketball coach is very strict.
example.py: Wǒmen de lánqiú jiàoliàn fēicháng yángé.

example.zh: 他在这个领域很有名。
example.en: He is well known in this field.
example.py: Tā zài zhège lǐngyù hěn yǒumíng.

example.zh: 你能说得再具体一点儿吗？
example.en: Could you be a bit more specific?
example.py: Nǐ néng shuō de zài jùtǐ yìdiǎnr ma?

example.zh: 冰箱里的食物都坏了。
example.en: The food in the fridge has all gone bad.
example.py: Bīngxiāng lǐ de shíwù dōu huài le.

example.zh: 医生说还需要再观察几天。
example.en: The doctor said a few more days of observation are needed.
example.py: Yīshēng shuō hái xūyào zài guānchá jǐtiān.

example.zh: 由于天气原因，今天的航班被取消了。
example.en: Due to the weather, today's flight was cancelled.
example.py: Yóuyú tiānqì yuányīn, jīntiān de hángbān bèi qǔxiāo le.

example.zh: 这个门是自动的，人一走近就开了。
